LanguageData.EWP_Bullet1: Every biome keeps its default plants
LanguageData.EWP_Bullet3: Cave plants as in the game
LanguageData.EWP_Bullet4: Gradual map overgrowth as you set it
LanguageData.EWP_Import: Import from Choose Wild Plant Spawns
LanguageData.EWP_ImportTip: Reads your settings from Choose Wild Plant Spawns (plant lists and density). Stumps, dead plants and plants from disabled mods are skipped. You can disable Choose Wild Plant Spawns afterwards.
LanguageData.EWP_ImportNone: No Choose Wild Plant Spawns settings found.
LanguageData.EWP_ImportDone: Imported: {0} biomes, {1} plants. Skipped {2} (stumps, dead plants, missing mods).
LanguageData.EWP_ResetAllConfirm: Reset all biomes to their default plants, density and regrowth?
LanguageData.EWP_PickBiome: Pick a biome on the left to see which wild plants grow there and how often.
LanguageData.EWP_DensityTip: How many wild plants are on the map. 0 = none, higher = denser nature. Evergrowth can multiply this further.
LanguageData.EWP_RegrowTip: How long until something grows again on a free spot. Fewer days = faster regrowth.
LanguageData.EWP_KindDeadTip: The game never spawns dead plants as wild plants.
LanguageData.EWP_KindStumpTip: Stumps are not plants that grow – just what is left of a tree.
LanguageData.EWP_KindCropTip: A crop that normally does not grow in the wild. It can grow, but the climate often does not suit it.
LanguageData.EWP_KindCaveTip: Cave plant – grows only under a rock roof.
LanguageData.EWP_KindWaterTip: Water plant – grows only in water or near the shore.
LanguageData.EWP_ProbMissing: {0} plants from the list are missing (mod disabled).
LanguageData.EWP_ProbDead: {0}× stump or dead plant – they never grow, you can remove them.
LanguageData.EWP_ProbCrops: {0}× crop – they often do not survive in the wild.
LanguageData.EWP_ProbNoLand: Nothing grows on land here (only water / caves).
LanguageData.EWP_ProbEmpty: The list is empty – nothing will grow in this biome.
LanguageData.EWP_ProbZeroDensity: Density is 0 – nothing will grow in this biome.
LanguageData.EWP_CaveIntro: Cave plants grow under rock roofs in every biome. Set how often each one appears (0 = never).
LanguageData.EWP_FixBiome: Wild plants follow the biome of the world tile
LanguageData.EWP_FixBiomeTip: Some map mods (e.g. Geological Landforms) report a different biome for the map than the tile has. The game then picks plants from one biome but weighs them by the other – and almost nothing grows on land. This fixes it.
LanguageData.EWP_NoGame: Load a game to see the state of the current map here.
LanguageData.EWP_MismatchFixed: The biomes differ – the fix is on, plants follow the tile.
LanguageData.EWP_MismatchWarn: The biomes differ and the fix is off – few plants may grow on land!
LanguageData.EWP_FillTip: One-time fill of the map up to full density with plants of mixed sizes. Skips the home area, zones and rooms.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOn: The mod sets itself up and works right away. Ideal for new players and anyone who does not want to tweak anything.
LanguageData.MUI_DescOffSame: Custom settings. Still the same as recommended.
LanguageData.MUI_ConfirmOn: Turn recommended settings on? Your changes ({0}) will be replaced with the recommended values.
LanguageData.MUI_Locked: Detailed settings are locked. Want to change them? Turn off the switch above – your values start from the recommended ones.
LanguageData.MUI_ChangedTip: Differs from the recommended setting ({0}). Click to restore the recommended value.
LanguageData.EWP_AddIntro: Every plant, tree, grass, bush and mushroom from the game, DLCs and mods – also ones that never grow in this biome.
LanguageData.EWP_GrowsNowhere: Does not grow in any biome by default.
LanguageData.EWP_MapDensityTip: How densely this map should be covered by wild plants (100 % = normal for the biome). Changes gradually – new plants grow in by themselves. Lowering it cuts nothing, it just stops adding plants.
LanguageData.EWP_FillDaysTip: In how many in-game days the map should reach the set overgrowth. Plants sprout small and grow at a normal pace.
LanguageData.EWP_FillGradualTip: Plants appear little by little as small sprouts and grow up by themselves. Skips the home area, zones and rooms.
LanguageData.EWP_FillStarted: The map will grow in gradually (target in {0} days).
LanguageData.EWP_FillRunning: The map is growing in – {0} days left, {1} % done.
LanguageData.EWP_LockedHere: Editing is locked because Recommended settings are on at the top (default plants).
LanguageData.EWP_ShowAllTip: Shows every plant from the game, DLCs and mods, also ones that normally do not grow here. Move a slider above 0 and the plant starts growing here.
LanguageData.EWP_ForageIntro: Wild plants that give food or medicine when harvested ({0} found, e.g. {1}).
LanguageData.EWP_ForageCommonTip: How often berries, agave, wild healroot and similar plants appear among the wild plants of every biome (also plants from mods). 1 = as set in the biome list, 0 = never.
LanguageData.EWP_ForageRegrowTip: How fast wild berries and herbs grow back after they were harvested or eaten. Sown plants in your zones are not affected.
LanguageData.EWP_GrassIntro: Grass and other plants animals graze ({0} found).
LanguageData.EWP_GrassRegrowTip: How fast grazed grass grows back – keeps animal pens fed longer.
LanguageData.EWP_GrassPensTip: The grass speed applies only to enclosed animal pens; grass on the rest of the map grows normally.
LanguageData.EWP_ProtectIntro: Wild plants of these kinds are never cut when you drag a cut or chop order over an area, sow a zone or build over them. Click a single plant with the cut order to cut it anyway.
LanguageData.EWP_ProtectedSkip: {0} is protected (Evergrowth – Wild Plants). Click it alone to cut it.
LanguageData.EWP_PresetsTip: Change all biomes at once: denser and faster, sparser and slower, or back to the game's own values.
LanguageData.EWP_PresetConfirm: Apply the preset "{0}" to all biomes? Your own density and regrowth values are replaced.
LanguageData.EWP_ShareTip: Copy all settings of this mod as one text code, or paste a code from a friend.
LanguageData.EWP_ShareCopy: Copy my settings as a code
LanguageData.EWP_ShareCopied: The code is in the clipboard.
LanguageData.EWP_SharePaste: Paste a code from the clipboard
LanguageData.EWP_SharePasteConfirm: Replace all settings of this mod with the code from the clipboard?
LanguageData.EWP_ShareBad: The clipboard does not hold a code of Evergrowth – Wild Plants.
LanguageData.EWP_ShareRead: Settings loaded from the code ({0} values).
LanguageData.EWP_WG_Button: Where does a plant grow here?
LanguageData.EWP_WG_ButtonTip: Pick a wild plant: the map shows where it grows well (green), slower or not right now (yellow) and not at all (red), with the reason under the mouse.
LanguageData.EWP_WG_InBiome: It is in this biome's list – it spawns by itself.
LanguageData.EWP_WG_NotInBiome: Not in this biome's list – it will not spawn by itself here.
LanguageData.EWP_WG_NeedsRoof: Needs a natural rock roof (cave plant).
LanguageData.EWP_WG_BuiltRoof: Under a built roof – wild plants do not grow here.
LanguageData.EWP_WG_Cold: Too cold right now ({0}) – grows in a warmer season.
